content.body:
The reliable Mauser Kar. 98 was also employed as a sniper weapon. A scope was added with 3x magnification.
Snipers were often recruited from the finest marksman in the force. They were assigned to hit high-value targets. Snipers were so highly-valued and respected among themselves that they often followed their own code of ethics. Among these ethical rules was that a sniper would not kill an enemy sniper unless it was absolutely necessary..
content.brief: WEAPON: Mauser Karabiner 98k AMMO: 7.92 mm Gewehr Patrone 98 sS MAGAZINE: 5 rounds (stripper clip) MUZZLE VELOCITY: 745 m/s RATE OF FIRE: Single-shot bolt action OTHER EQUIPMENT: Telescopic Sight (mounted on rifle) NbHgn 39 Smoke Grenades (4) Combat Knife
content.title: Scharfschütze (Sniper)
